globalFooter.title: MindWell Support – Open Source Mental Health Platform
globalFooter.desc1: MindWell is an open-source mental health education and wellbeing platform focused on awareness, self-reflection, and ethical access to support.
globalFooter.desc2: It is not a diagnostic or emergency service, and is designed for global and low-resource communities.
globalFooter.desc3: Aligned with SDG 3 (Good Health & Well-being) and SDG 4 (Quality Education).
globalFooter.desc4: Clinical support is available through assistant clinical psychologists. Currently, two psychologists are available, with more being added gradually. The first consultation session is free and is not intended to replace emergency or hospital care.
